data.narrative:
Swift Beat is a Series A-stage Defense & Security company founded by Eric Schmidt that has raised $50M+. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of ten same-sector, same/adjacent-stage peers—two public companies and eight private firms including Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Shield AI—with valuations ranging from $125M to $3.0B.

Two triangulation methods are applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $50M total raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A progression, yielding $100M. Peer-median analysis across the ten-company comp set produces a $1.0B implied valuation, with sample peers spanning $1.0B to $3.0B at Series B stage. The peer range spans $125M to $3.0B.

Synthesizing these methods produces a triangulated range of $85M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $550M. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty around trajectory and relative positioning within the Defense & Security sector. Key sensitivities include revenue growth rates, customer concentration, and how the target's technology roadmap compares to more mature Series B cohort peers. Given the stage, post-money valuation in the $300M–$700M range would align the company toward the lower-to-median portion of the peer distribution while preserving capital efficiency for subsequent rounds.
